rationale: Fundraising due diligence is episodic but high-stakes: founders facing their first investor request scramble to assemble documents they've never prepared, and the cost of delay is a missed deal. Evidence from multiple forums, startup communities, and competitor products (Docsend, Visible.vc, Capshare) confirms both the pain and willingness to pay. A low-cost self-serve template kit at $49–97 sits below the pricing floor of all incumbent solutions, occupying a validated but underserved price tier.
